purpose: Represent a source-backed lineage/subspecies as an exact-version delta over a base SpeciesDefinition without copying the parent record, inventing relationship evidence, or creating lineage-local shared mechanics.
source_basis: MVPS.SpeciesDefinition lineage_refs: lineages/subspecies remain distinct layers and do not overwrite base species identity
MVPS.CharacterSpeciesSelection: lineage selections are references/receipts and inheritance semantics belong to MVPS-08
PPIA05-AC-008: lineage/subspecies/variant relationships require explicit source-backed evidence; same-name, shared-document or visual similarity is insufficient
MVPS-06 duplicate/stacking invariant: duplicate, stacking, suppression and replacement behavior remains with shared owners

parent_species_ref.rule: A lineage binds to the exact parent SpeciesDefinition version it modifies. Version mismatch is unresolved/migration-required, never silently retargeted.

relationship_evidence.rule: Lineage/subspecies identity must be established by explicit source/canon relationship evidence.

operation_requirements.add_reference: record_ref required; adds a referenced record/layer contribution without copying it
operation_requirements.exclude_reference: record_ref required; explicitly excludes an inherited referenced contribution where source authority permits
operation_requirements.remove_reference: expected_parent_ref required; removes an exact inherited reference only with source-backed authority
operation_requirements.replace_reference: expected_parent_ref and replacement_ref required; replacement is explicit and source-traceable
operation_requirements.override_descriptive_value: value required; allowed only on non-executable descriptive fields and cannot create mechanics

delta_operation_contract.rule: Every operation is an attributable delta against a named target path. Executable mechanics remain canonical shared-record references.
